tools.name: verify_session
tools.description: Verify the calling provider and bind this call to one pre-authorisation request. Call before any other tool.

conversation_id.description: Set as dynamic variable {{system__conversation_id}}; never ask the caller.

tools.name: get_case_blockers
tools.description: Return what is preventing the verified request from being review-ready, with rule and policy version.

conversation_id.description: Set as dynamic variable {{system__conversation_id}}; never ask the caller.

tools.name: record_evidence_reference
tools.description: Record the reference of a document the caller supplies on the call. References only; no document content is sent.

doc_type.description: The document type named by get_case_blockers, e.g. prior_conservative_treatment

doc_ref.description: The reference the caller reads out, confirmed back to them first

conversation_id.description: Set as dynamic variable {{system__conversation_id}}; never ask the caller.

tools.name: recheck_case
tools.description: Re-run the completeness and rule checks after evidence was recorded, and return the updated state.

conversation_id.description: Set as dynamic variable {{system__conversation_id}}; never ask the caller.

tools.name: send_to_review
tools.description: Place the case in the qualified reviewer's queue. This does not decide the request; a qualified employee does.

tier.description: The tier from get_case_blockers or higher: tier_0_standard_review, tier_1_priority_review, tier_2_mandatory_human. A lower tier is raised back by the control plane.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what was resolved on the call

conversation_id.description: Set as dynamic variable {{system__conversation_id}}; never ask the caller.

tools.name: transfer_to_human
tools.description: Pass the caller to a member of the team, or arrange a callback. A callback needs the caller's explicit consent.

reason.description: Why the call is being transferred, e.g. caller asked for a human, clinical question

callback.description: True when the caller wants to be called back instead of holding

consent.description: True only when the caller has explicitly agreed to be called back

conversation_id.description: Set as dynamic variable {{system__conversation_id}}; never ask the caller.
